create_plot_weighted_samples: create a plot of weighted samples where point size is proportional to sample weight
build_sgd_classifier_weighted: build an SGDClassifier model with sample weights to fit a weighted dataset
build_sgd_classifier_unweighted: build an SGDClassifier model without sample weights to fit an unweighted dataset
test_decision_function: test the SGDClassifier decision_function to generate contour levels for decision boundary
review_sample_weight_scatter: review plotting weighted data points using scatter with sample_weight controlling point size
